# PRA Psykiatrisk Klinik 2 - Randers

## Synthesis

PRA Psykiatrisk Klinik 2 - Randers is a clinical unit named in the Danish ADHD quality-database report for 2024 (ADHD_2024.pdf). The clinic appears twice in the source material, both times in tables reporting performance on quality indicators tracked by the national ADHD database.

In the first reported result, the clinic achieved only 27% fulfillment of the relevant indicator, based on 3 out of 11 treatment courses meeting the standard, with a confidence interval of 6–61 [^src1]. This figure is significantly below the national development target of 90% [^src1]. According to the surrounding documentation, this section of the report concerns Indicator 10 of the ADHD database, which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's social support needs were assessed within 120 days of starting treatment — the first time this particular indicator has been reported. Nationally, fulfillment stood at only 37%, and regionally it ranged from 14% to 52%, far short of the 90% target; the steering group ("Styregruppen") discussed likely causes, including registration practices and data quality issues from child/adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and resolved to work on improving registration practices.

In a second table, the clinic's figures improve markedly: 6 out of 11 treatment courses met the relevant standard, giving 55% fulfillment, with a confidence interval of 23–83 [^src2]. This later result sits in the part of the report covering Indicator 11, which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which the patient was receiving ADHD medication within 120 days of the start of a so-called "package course" (pakkeforløb) — also reported for adults for the first time, since the ADHD database was expanded to include adult patients in 2024. That section notes substantial regional variation nationally (for example, Region Nordjylland at 85% versus Region Hovedstaden at 37%), attributed more likely to registration difficulties than to real differences in clinical practice.

No relationships or standalone claims involving this clinic beyond the quoted table figures are present in the source data, and no timeline events are recorded for the entity specifically.
